diagnosis.accepted_objection: V2 converted a scoreable reviewer contradiction (claimed defect without concrete witness) into a transport/schema failure, preventing the zero-contradiction qualification rule from scoring it.

semantic_packet_reuse.justification: V2 qualification failed before semantic review; exact packet exposure was 0/130, so the packet remains unseen by the reviewer.

v3_changes.structured_contradiction_policy: observed_defect=true with missing/empty/NONE witness or observed_defect=false without exact NONE is a structured contradiction.
v3_changes.transport_parser_policy: Parseable closed rows with witness null are preserved as qualification evidence, not retried as transport failures.
v3_changes.witness_contract: Always present. NONE means no defect; a claimed defect requires a concrete non-NONE witness.
